title: Shel-Haven Tube, Kayak, and Canoe Rental
specs: Float down the scenic Manistee River with no time limit
No stated age limit; river is suitable for kids and those with no experience
Pets allowed if wearing approved pet life vest, especially small dogs
includes: Transportation upriver to Longs Canoe Livery where equipment is waiting
Use of canoe, kayak, or tube for self-guided float down the Manistee River
blurb: Guests park at Shel-Haven and are transported upriver to Longs Canoe Livery where their equipment awaits. They float down the Manistee River at their own pace, with no time limit, returning to Shel-Haven where their vehicle is parked. The river trip can last from about 2 to 4 hours or longer depending on the guest's pace and stops.
extraNote: No set departure times; arrive anytime before 4 pm; shuttle runs until 7 pm · Public Act 183 of 2006 limits owner liability for risks inherent in non-motorized boat use · Shel-Haven Canoe Livery, 11852 W. M-72 Hwy, Grayling, MI 49738
